name: Tiszaeszlár (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tiszaeszlár: a green and blue shield with a yellow sheaf of grain, a cross and a wavy stripe, above a green scroll inscribed Tiszaeszlár.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
